data.name: BASHDASH
data.detailed_description:
BASHDASH is a frantic multiplayer party game for up to 8 players where bizarre physics, unpredictable obstacles, and pure sabotage collide. Every map is a completely new experience with its own unique style, traps, and objectives. Race your friends, master the wild ragdoll physics, and overcome the mayhem. One moment you're confidently sprinting toward victory; the next, a hidden trap launches you far from your goal.

Welcome to BASHDASH. Trust no one. Expect anything.

FEATURES

  • CONSTANTLY EVOLVING: A NEW MAP EVERY TWO WEEKS
    The chaos never gets old. After launch, a brand-new map drops every two weeks, bringing a completely fresh concept, new mechanics, unpredictable hazards, and spectacular new ways to stumble.

  • CHAOS, COMEDY & UNEXPECTED HORROR
    Not every map is just sunshine and laughs. You might go from a highly entertaining obstacle course to a terrifying nightmare sequence. Enter creepy houses, unsettling environments, and bizarre scenarios where you never quite know whether to laugh at your friends or run for your life.

  • PHYSICS-DRIVEN MAYHEM
    Jump, fall, collide, and watch even the simplest move turn into a spectacular disaster. Physical sabotage is encouraged: push, punch, shove, and body-block your friends to delay their plans. Sometimes pure skill will win you the match—sometimes, gravity will.

  • STRANGE OBJECTIVES & UNPREDICTABLE TRAPS
    Forget the standard "reach the finish line." Each map introduces unique and surprising objectives that you must complete before everyone else. The environment is constantly working against you, with unpredictable traps and obstacles built directly into each map. You can't control them—you just have to adapt and overcome them.

  • NO PERMANENT ELIMINATIONS, JUST ENDLESS HUMILIATION
    Getting knocked around doesn't mean you're out. Traps, falls, and player sabotage won't kick you out of the match—they just cause hilarious delays, knock you off course, or launch you far from your goal. You are always in the race, scrambling to recover from the latest disaster and catch up to your friends!

AT A GLANCE:

  • Up to 8 Players

  • A Brand-New Map Every Two Weeks After Launch

  • Wild Ragdoll Physics & Physical Sabotage

  • Strange Objectives & Unpredictable Traps

  • Hilarious Comedy Meets Unexpected Horror

  • No Permanent Eliminations—You're Always in the Race!

data.short_description: A chaotic 8-player party game where wild physics, brutal traps, and sabotage turn every match into madness! No permanent eliminations—get launched away, bounce back, and keep fighting. Shove your friends, get ragdolled, outsmart tricky traps, and dash through ever-changing maps. Only ONE can win!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) or AMD® Ryzen™ 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 570 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
